description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'FlexibleStringExpander' that handles string expressions with embedded EL (Expression Language) syntax, supporting nested expressions, scripts, and currency formatting. It includes inner classes for different expression types and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander
classes.description: An abstract class for expanding strings with embedded EL expressions, supporting nested expressions, scripts, currency formatting, and caching.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.ArrayOffsetString
classes.description: Abstract class representing a string segment with offset and length.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.ConstOffsetElem
classes.description: Represents a constant string segment with offset and length.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.CurrElem
classes.description: Represents a currency expression element with currency code and value.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.Elements
classes.description: Container for multiple expression fragments, concatenated.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.ScriptElem
classes.description: Represents a script expression (Groovy or BSH) to be evaluated.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander.NestedVarElem
classes.description: Represents a nested expression composed of multiple sub-expressions.

methods.name: containsConstant
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains a string constant.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains an EL expression.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if the expression contains a script element.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Evaluates the expression with given context, locale, and timezone, returning a string.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached instance of FlexibleStringExpander for a given expression.
